svg.title: Selector lifecycle
svg.desc: A selector is registered and its first option picked (selector.selected), then calculating the options that have no price yet (selector.calculating), then priced (selector.calculated). When every option already has a price from the last 10 minutes it goes straight to priced (selector.calculated). Pricing that fails moves calculating to unpriced (sdk.error) and the options show package prices. Changing the picked option's quantity or a slot sends selector.selected and calculates again.
